title: Personal synthetic acceptance batch approval input; no live egress grant
description: Owner + Project Maintainer and configured Origin are required before strict bounded parsing. Approval binds separate operator-controlled source review and explicit caller consent; it creates metadata only, not a model request or network permission.

syntheticInventoryId.description: Trusted deployment inventory must review this exact Project and computed manifest. Missing, malformed, expired or changed operator-controlled proof fails closed; caller assertions do not prove provenance.

manifestSha256.description: Must equal server digest of ordered immutable request templates, resource bindings and projected input/citation hashes.

expiresAt.description: Future, at most 24 hours; not later than acknowledgement, price or operator inventory expiry.

maxCostMicrousd.description: No more than maxRequests*4200; USD micro-units, not supplier invoice amount.
